scope: Independent public English SMS diagnostic, local action rules only; spam is not a fraud ground-truth label. No model training or tuning on this corpus. URLs and live evidence excluded. No SMS text sent to providers.
citation: Almeida & Hidalgo (2011), SMS Spam Collection, UCI, DOI 10.24432/C5CC84
limitations: Historical largely non-Indian English SMS. Spam-flag coverage is NOT scam recall. Most spam can be advertising, and UNSURE is expected. Does not establish current Indian multilingual fraud accuracy.
